title.narrative: Thematic Programme Climate Change and Sustainable Energy

description.narrative:
The Climate Resilient Rural Infrastructure Project (CRRIP) under the Thematic Programme Climate Change and Sustainable Energy has been part of the Bangladesh Country Programme 2016-2021. The objective of CRRIP was to construct and maintain climate resilient rural roads and other rural infrastructure through contracts with poor women organized in Labour Contracting Societies (LCS). The project has been co-funded by Denmark and the Government of Bangladesh (GoB). CRRIP was implemented by the Local Government Engineering Division (LGED) of Bangladesh Government. CRRIP started project implementation in February 2017.
In March 2018, all CRRIP project activities were suspended due to reports of irregularities. Subsequently, in September 2018, Danida support was withdraw and the project was closed down. At the same time, it was decided that a select number of Danida financed road constructions be finalised as part of the withdrawal. Therefore, no reporting beyond 2017.
"Enhanced resilience and adaptive capacity in terms of climate change as well as improved access to renewable and efficient energy".
